subject: [ARMv7] Reroll and block Clang autovec in mergeAccs
perf_evidence: Commit message says a four-step loop and ARMv7 Clang vectorization guard improve XXH3 throughput and size.
change_summary: Rerolls XXH3_mergeAccs and inserts an empty inline-assembly barrier in the ARMv7 NEON Clang path.

units.name: raw XXH3_mergeAccs, ARMv7 NEON with the actual autovectorization guard
units.evidence: Both Alive2 directions time out on the changed ARMv7 NEON path. Disabling the barrier on both sides permits a separate raw bidirectional proof, but omits the performance-relevant guard.

units.name: public XXH3 64/128-bit fixed long-input ARMv7 NEON paths
units.evidence: Three public fixed-length targets remain inconclusive; only old-to-new for one 256-byte target passes.

units.name: public x86-64-v3 fixed-length control
units.evidence: Three fixed-length x86 control targets pass bidirectional Alive2.

notes: The no-guard variant isolates the arithmetic reroll but is not a proof of the full ARMv7 optimization.
